questions.q: How many 'S' are there in the following series that come immediately before K and immediately after K ? SSKSKSRKSPOKSKSKS
questions.solution: Count only the S letters in KSK triplets. Three positions satisfy both neighbour conditions.

questions.q: In the given question, there are two words to the left of the sign :: which are connected in some way. The same relationship obtains between the third word and one of the four alternatives under it. Find the correct alternative. Sugar: Sweet :: Lemon:?
questions.solution: Match the food with its characteristic taste. Sugar is sweet and lemon is sour.

questions.q: If 'A $ B' means 'A is the father of B'; 'A # B' means 'A is the mother of B'; 'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B', then how is W related to U in W #X × V$U?
questions.solution: W is X’s mother; X is V’s sister; V is U’s father. W is U’s grandmother.

questions.q: In a certain code, 48 means "which school" and 968 means "college and school". What is the code for school?
questions.solution: The common word school appears in both phrases. Their only shared digit is 8.

questions.q: Find the dissimilar term. 3X5, 4U3, 2R4, 3O2, 1M3.
questions.solution: The middle letters go X,U,R,O, then should be L, subtracting three positions each time. M breaks the sequence.

questions.q: Find the dissimilar number. 1, 3, 12, 60, 340.
questions.solution: Multiply by 3,4,5,6 successively: 1,3,12,60,360. The printed 340 is incorrect.

questions.q: A person performing yoga starts facing North and then turns 90 degrees counterclockwise followed by another 180 degrees counterclockwise. What direction is the person facing now ?
questions.solution: The combined turn is 270° anticlockwise from north. This is the same as 90° clockwise, ending east.

questions.q: A person walking towards North-West direction sees his left hand in which direction?
questions.solution: A 90° turn to the left of north-west points south-west.

questions.q: Complete the series 9, 72, 243, 576, _______
questions.solution: The terms are 9×1³,9×2³,9×3³,9×4³. Next is 9×5³=1125.

questions.q: If DEEP is coded as 30, SEA as 25, then RIVER will be coded as
questions.solution: Add alphabetical positions: DEEP=4+5+5+16=30, SEA=19+5+1=25. RIVER=18+9+22+5+18=72.

questions.q: Which among the following is not a leap year?
questions.solution: 2014 is not divisible by 4. The other listed years are divisible by 4 and are leap years.

questions.q: Find the value of x and y in the following series: U4, R8, O16, x, I64, F128, y
questions.solution: Letters move back three positions and numbers double. After O16 comes L32; after F128 comes C256.

questions.q: Complete the analogy: Thermometer: Temperature :: Odometer: ?
questions.solution: A thermometer measures temperature; an odometer measures distance travelled.

questions.q: Find the odd one from the given alternatives.
questions.solution: June has 30 days. May, March and July each have 31.

questions.q: Find the odd one out in the series. A1, C9, E25, G49, I89
questions.solution: The letters occupy positions 1,3,5,7,9, and the numbers should be their squares. I should pair with 81 rather than 89.

questions.q: A is the son of C; C and Q are sisters; Z is the mother of Q and P is the son of Z. Which of the following statements is true?
options: Q is the maternal grandfather of A.
P is the maternal uncle of A.
questions.solution: C is A’s mother; C and Q share mother Z. P is Z’s son and C’s brother, making him A’s maternal uncle.

questions.q: Find the word that does not belong to the set.
questions.solution: Steel is an alloy. Copper, lead and tin are chemical elements.

questions.q: Consider the conditions for selecting faculty members in a computer education centre: a. Age between 23 to 28 years. b. Work experience or programming experience. c. Postgraduate degree in computer application with at least 60% marks. d. Minimum of 25 marks in the interview out of 50. e. If the candidate does not have PG, the case is to be referred to the senior faculty member. f. If the candidate does not have work experience, the case is to be referred to Principal of the institute. g. If the candidate satisfies all other qualifications except the age limit, the case is to be referred to the Director of the Centre. Which course of action should be taken for Babli Sarkar based on the following information ? Babli Sarkar: MCA with 68% marks. Age 30 years. 2.5 years of experience as a programmer. Obtained 40 marks in the interview.
options: Candidate is not to be selected
Case is to be referred to the Director of the Centre
Candidate is to be selected as a junior faculty member
questions.solution: Babli meets the degree, experience and interview criteria but exceeds the age limit. Rule g requires referral to the Director.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series. 145, 155, 175, 205, 245, ?
questions.solution: The differences rise by 10: 10,20,30,40,50. Next term = 245+50=295.

questions.q: A cylinder is intersected by a plane inclined at an angle of 60 degrees to its axis. What is the shape of the resulting cross-section ?
questions.solution: An oblique plane cutting a cylinder’s curved surface produces an elliptical cross-section.

questions.q: If 'BEAR' is coded as '25-22-26-9', how will 'TIGER' be coded?
questions.solution: Use reverse alphabetical positions: B=25,E=22,A=26,R=9. TIGER becomes 7-18-20-22-9.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series. 16, 10, 20, 14, 24,_____
questions.solution: Subtract 6, then add 10 alternately. After 24, subtract 6 to get 18.

questions.q: If '#' stands for 'x', what is 3#5?
questions.solution: Replace # with multiplication: 3×5=15.

questions.q: If $a \sim b = a^2+b$, $a \wedge b= b^2 + a$, find $(3 \sim 6) \wedge 2$.
Find the next number in the given number series. 126, 112, 98, 84, 70,______________,
questions.solution: Subtract 14 each time. The next term is 70−14=56.

questions.q: Read the Statement and Conclusions given and decide which of the statement(s) is/are valid. Statement: An apple is good for an individual's health. Conclusions: 1. Apples are a good way to keep someone healthy and fit. 2. Grapes are better than apples.
questions.solution: The statement supports apples helping health. It says nothing comparing apples with grapes.

questions.q: Find the missing number in the given analogy. 25: 625:: 35:_________
questions.solution: 625=25². Applying the same rule gives 35²=1225.

questions.q: What direction are you facing at the moment, if you start by facing south-east and turn around 225 degrees anti-clockwise?
questions.solution: South-east has bearing 135°. Subtracting 225° gives −90°, equivalent to 270° or west.

questions.q: Find the next letter cluster in the given series. DA, HE, NK, RO, XU,___________
questions.solution: Each cluster has a three-position gap between its letters. The first letters advance alternately by 4 and 6 positions, wrapping after Z. After XU comes BY.

questions.q: Complete the analogy: Engineer: Blueprint:: Chef:
questions.solution: An engineer works from a blueprint. A chef works from a recipe.

questions.q: What will be the next letter? E:H::N:?
questions.solution: Move forward three positions: E→H and N→Q.

questions.q: Which of the following pairs is different from the others?
questions.solution: A cow moos; bleating is associated with sheep or goats. The other animal–sound pairs match.

questions.q: "The company's decision to downsize was prudent." What does the word "prudent" imply about the company's decision to downsize ?
questions.solution: Prudent means sensible or wise, especially when considering consequences.

questions.q: Determine which of the provided words cannot be formed using the letters of the given word PUNISHMENT.
questions.solution: PUNISHMENT contains no A. Therefore PAIN cannot be formed from its letters.
